item.description: ...Intensify search for fleeing gang members The Police Command in Nasarawa State says it has neutralised one suspected kidnapper in Nasarawa-Eggon Local Government Area (LGA) of the state

item.title: African bunkering hubs gain as ships reroute around the Cape
item.description: Ship-refuelling companies along Africa's coast are seeing a surge in business as more vessels divert around the Cape of Good Hope, with war in the Middle East ​reshaping global shipping routes and boosting the continent's role as a bunkering hub

item.title: Ibadan Court Remands man for Protecting Suspected Arms Dealer
item.description: A Federal High Court in Ibadan, on Monday, ordered the remand of one Isaac Busuyi, 49, after he pleaded guilty to concealing information about arms dealing from security agencies

item.title: Malami condemns EFCC invasion of his premises
item.description: Former Attorney General of the Federation and Minister of Justice Abubakar Malami, SAN, has accused the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) of unlawful invasion of his residential and business premises

item.title: CPPE rejects proposal to impose additional tax on beverage sector
item.description: The Centre for the Promotion of Private Enterprise (CPPE) has opposed calls for additional taxation on Sugar-Sweetened Beverages (SSBs), describing the proposal as ill-conceived and poorly timed

item.title: WorldStage to present Nigeria’s Macroeconomic Outlook 2026 on Thursday
item.description: World Stage Limited (WorldStage), a Nigerian based research and technology driven global focused firm has announced plans to present its Nigeria’s Macroeconomic Outlook 2026 on Thursday, March 26, 2026 at the LCCI-BOI Innovation Hub, Nurudeen Olowpopo Street, Alausa Ikeja Lagos by 10AM.

item.title: Otti delivers, Sanusi chairs 2026 _TheNiche_Lecture
item.description: All is now set for the 2026 _TheNiche_ Annual Lecture. This year’s edition, which will be the fifth in the series, will hold on Thursday, April 23, at the Nigerian Institute of International Affairs (NIIA), Kofo Abayomi Street, Victoria Island, Lagos. The event will start at 10 am prompt.

item.title: Oborevwori inaugurates LG, ward coordinators of Renewed Hope Ambassadors
item.description: Delta State Governor, Rt. Hon. Sheriff Oborevwori, Tuesday, inaugurated the Local Government and Ward Coordinators of the Renewed Hope Ambassadors, marking a significant expansion of the movement's grassroots reach across the state.

item.title: POSTSCRIPT: From intent to outcomes - President Tinubu's state visit to the United Kingdom, by Sunday Dare
item.description: If President Tinubu's visit to London was framed as a strategic reset, its conclusion has now provided something more important: proper evidence of execution.

item.title: Tinubu extols long-time aide, Tunde Rahman, on 60th birthday
item.description: President Bola Tinubu has extolled Mr. Tunde Rahman, his Senior Special Assistant on Media and Special Duties, for his commitment to duty and loyalty over the years.

item.title: Court orders final forfeiture of $13m linked to Aisha Achimugu’s company
item.description: The Federal High Court (FHC) in Abuja, on Wednesday, made an order for final forfeiture of the sum of 13 million dollars linked to Aisha Achimugu’s Oceangate Engineering Oil & Gas Ltd

item.title: NPC Registers Over 36,000 Births in Kano via New Electronic System in 9 months - Official
item.description: The National Population Commission (NPC) has said it registered over 36,000 births in Kano State in nine months of deploying its electronic birth registration system

item.title: NDLEA says drug abuse drives HIV transmission
item.description: The National Drug Law Enforcement Agency (NDLEA) has identified drug abuse as a major driver of HIV transmission in Nigeria, and called for integrated strategies to address both challenges

item.title: Police detains village head over alleged illegal possession of firearm

item.title: Court faults El-Rufai’s N1bn rights suit against ICPC, IGP, others
item.description: The Federal High Court in Abuja on Wednesday, picked holes in the fundamental rights enforcement suit filed by former Gov. Nasir El-Rufai of Kaduna State
